label: Diagram 26
caption: Diagram 26 Grab rails and fittings associated with a bath
description:
Diagram 26, titled "Grab rails and fittings associated with a bath," is a technical line drawing in two views: an elevation (side) at the top and a plan (top) at the bottom.

The elevation shows a bath in side profile with a "Vertical grab rail (500mm min. length)" and a "Horizontal grab rail" mounted at its head. An "Alarm pull cord" hangs from above. Dimensions read "600mm" across the top, "200mm" vertically, "75–100mm" to the right, "480mm*" and "150mm min*" on the left. A note states "Alternatively rail partially cranked at max. 13° to horizontal." A footnoted asterisk reads "To meet both these criteria, a shallower than normal bath may be needed." Labels below indicate "Gap clear of bath supports" and "Gap where necessary to allow for the use of a mobile hoist."

The plan shows the bath from above with an "Alarm pull cord" ("200mm"), "50–60mm clearance between wall and handrail," "250mm," "Mixer tap," a hatched "Purpose made transfer seat at head of bath," a dashed "Proprietary transfer seat supported on bath rim," "Bath length," and "400mm min. depth."
